summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration_42 changes: (1) deck-steam on steampunk landed card, (2) reveal-card steam-burst still fires and unmounts, (3) dark theme has no steam and still shows skeleton-hands, (4) theme dropdown labels renamed to 'Reaper (Original)' and 'Coffee Shop' with theme switching still functional. All three targeted flows PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: ShufflingDeck.jsx line ~257: deck-steam AnimatePresence exit not used — steam strip unmounts abruptly when reveal transitions in. Not user-visible because the popup unmounts entirely, but consider wrapping in AnimatePresence for consistency with other overlays.

SteamBurst defaults (startBottom='45%', travel=-170) are duplicated between reveal usage and deck usage; deck passes override startBottom='-10%', travel=-120. Fine as is, but the two callsites' relationship should be commented so future edits keep them consistent.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage seeded via add_init_script: ff_theme, ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_theme_hint_seen=1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: Home shows a GuidedFlow overlay on first visit even with ff_theme_hint_seen=1. The correct dismissal is clicking the 'Skip intro' button (get_by_role('button', name='Skip intro')) — a text_content match on 'Skip intro' also works but only after the guided modal is rendered. Only clicking Skip intro once is needed on step 1/4. Also: theme dropdown uses Radix portal — the [data-testid='theme-menu'] wrapper's `visible` check can time out even though items ARE portalled to document root. Query items directly with [data-testid='theme-option-*']. Verified FF_BUILD deck-steam wrapper exists at ShufflingDeck.jsx ~L257 gated on landed && theme==='steam', with inner SteamBurst.

test_evidence.test_1_theme_labels: PASS — Dark item innerText == 'Reaper (Original)', Light item innerText == 'Coffee Shop'. After clicking each, document.documentElement.dataset.ffTheme became 'light' and 'dark' respectively.
test_evidence.test_2_dark_regression: PASS — On ff_theme=dark, polled every ~120ms during shuffle→landed→reveal: saw_deck_steam=False, saw_skeleton=True, saw_reveal=True. No steam ever appeared; skeleton-hands-overlay rendered.
test_evidence.test_3_steampunk_deck_steam: PASS — On ff_theme=steam, polled every ~100ms: [data-testid=deck-steam] appeared on landed card, containing [data-testid=steam-burst] (burst_in_deck=True). Screenshot captured at /app/test_reports/browser_iter42/steam_deck_landed.jpeg shows the FATE HAS CHOSEN landed card (Spago) with the deck-steam strip mounted above it. Reveal card followed with its own steam-burst inside [data-testid=reveal-photo-header], and that inner steam-burst count went to 0 after ~4.5s (unmount confirmed).
